children: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is probing suspicious oil trading activity around the US war in Iran, the agency's enforcement director David Miller said on Thursday at a conference in New York.

Bloomberg News reported last week that a CFTC political appointee had told market surveillance staff to retract a referral to the agency's enforcement team identifying suspicious trading around President Trump's March decision to back away from strikes on Iran's power plants.
When asked about the story during a panel at the conference, Miller said the agency had "from the beginning" been probing the trading and that the investigation remained open.
